what_this_is: The showcase vault — brothers' shipped work, linked and vouched. Every entry is a real repo or site that exists. To add yours: copy an entry's shape, fill your real link, get one brother to vouch, PR it. build.yml checks that links resolve (HEAD request).

entry_shape.receipt_note: one line: what it does + why it counts
